title: Kineto References
description: Text the director brought in from an outside source (an MCP tool, ADR-0007) as material for the bible: the server and tool it came from, the arguments it was asked with, the text and its hash, and what it is about, the world (bible_world) or bible entries by the IDs work depends on them by. IDs are reference.NNNN and never reused; next_number is the next one's number. No time is recorded.

server.description: A registered server ID: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, at most 48.

items.description: bible_world, or bible_character., bible_location. or bible_prop. and an entry ID.
